pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Nine-Leaf Immortal Orchid is an elegant spiritual herb distinguished by its nine leaves. Ancient tales claim that each leaf holds a separate thread of pure natural essence. It grows in peaceful, flourishing environments and is treasured by cultivators for its refined spiritual nature.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Cherry groves, meadows, lush caves, and flower forests.
